data_fields.name: armour_constant_K
data_fields.donor_constant: per-level DB2 expected_stat ArmorConstant (values not read)

data_fields.name: pen_growth_above_59
data_fields.donor_constant: 4.5 x 85 x (level - 59) added at level 60 and up

best_idea: A diminishing mitigation curve a/(a+K) with a hard cap, floored to an integer and applied once in the damage step, with penetration that removes a share of a capped amount rather than of raw armour.
decision_why: Frankendom has no flat armour stat; the curve shape and cap are worth taking only if they stay inside the one damage step with one rounding rule. Take the shape, not the WoW stat, DB2 table or level constants.
acceptance: A server test asserts: with armour 0 the hit is unchanged; at any armour the mitigated hit is an integer and not below floor(0.15 x raw); doubling armour gives less than double the reduction.
